text_blocks.snippet: Small cell lung cancer (SCLC) is a highly aggressive form of lung cancer, accounting for about 15% of all lung cancer cases. It is characterized by small, oval-shaped cancer cells and tends to grow and spread quickly, often to other parts of the body like the brain, liver, and bones. While it responds well to chemotherapy and radiation, SCLC frequently recurs after treatment.
